description: Phase 9 constrained selection (D7): candidate pool from frozen MiniLM retrieval, hard eligibility rules outside the objective, CP-SAT with integer costs and an explicitly scaled integer objective, the independent Phase 5 validator, and explicit statuses. The objective weights are chosen on the dev basket scenarios (gold input) by the rule below, which was written before any dev result was computed.
test_split: data/benchmarks/basket_test.json is not read in Phase 9; E3/E4 run on it once in Phase 11 with this frozen config.

candidates.expand_when: a line has no eligible option in the pool, or the pool model is infeasible: rebuild that model from every eligible catalog product and solve again (logged as no_basket_in_candidate_pool -> expanded)

eligibility: same ingredient and unit, available, every requested diet "allowed" (unknown fails), ingredient not excluded; these hard rules decide which options exist and never enter the objective
constraints: exactly one option per remaining requirement line
sum of chosen option costs (integer minor units) <= budget_minor when a budget is given

terms.relevance: mean over lines of the chosen option's retrieval score in [0, 1]
terms.history: mean over lines of history_score(user, product) in [0, 1] (0 without a user)
terms.pair: mean over pairs of lines of pair_score(chosen products) in [0, 1], via AND-linked Booleans y <= x_a, y <= x_b; a pair of lines whose option pairs all score the same is added as a constant (no variables)
terms.cost: chosen cost / sum over lines of the line's most expensive option cost, in [0, 1] (penalty)
terms.surplus: mean over lines of surplus / amount bought, in [0, 1) (penalty)

objective.integer_coefficients: round(scale * weight * normalised term) per option or option pair
objective.fixed_weights_reason: Phase 8 measured that the history and pair terms cannot change which product is chosen (ingredient-level scores); they are kept and logged at a small weight. Relevance is the anchor weight.

selection.rule: highest dev success (gold input, all 50 scenarios, scored as in E0 with infeasible_in_scope as the correct outcome for infeasible scenarios); ties go to the lower mean cost ratio (basket total / checker minimum) over feasible scenarios with a valid basket, then to the lower mean surplus share, then to the earlier grid entry (cost first, then surplus)

budget_conflict: when the budget makes the full-catalog model infeasible, solve the minimum-cost complete basket under the same diet and exclusion rules and report its total as suggested_budget_minor; the request is never relaxed silently
